cards.name: Spirit of Flames
cards.effect: Special Summon from hand by banishing 1 FIRE monster from the team's shared Graveyard; +300 ATK only during its controller's Battle Phase.

cards.name: The Rock Spirit
cards.effect: Special Summon from hand by banishing 1 EARTH monster from the team's shared Graveyard; +300 ATK only during the opponent team's Battle Phase.

cards.name: Garuda the Wind Spirit
cards.effect: Special Summon from hand by banishing 1 WIND monster from the team's shared Graveyard; once per turn in the opponent End Phase, change one face-up opposing monster's battle position.

historicalScope.reason: All three first TCG releases precede the historical cutoff.
